senses.en: the legal relationship of being married

ex.en: They announced their marriage in the spring.
ex.zh: 他们在春天宣布结婚。

ex.en: Laws about marriage affect housing, tax and the way a family is recorded at school.
ex.zh: 关于婚姻的法律会影响住房、税收，以及学校如何登记一个家庭。

tip: 结婚的动词是 marry，不说 marriage with。

senses.en: a series of games to find a winner

ex.en: The tournament is next month.
ex.zh: 锦标赛在下个月。

ex.en: A tournament that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can play.
ex.zh: 在末班车之后才开始的锦标赛，其实已经选定了谁能参赛。

tip: tournament 可数。比单一的 match 更长。

senses.en: the direction between south and west

ex.en: The wind came from the south-west.
ex.zh: 风从西南来。

ex.en: Towns in the south-west share one hospital, so the road between them matters in bad weather.
ex.zh: 西南部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路在坏天气里很重要。

tip: south-west 也可写作 southwest。

senses.en: having a baby developing inside the body

ex.en: The form asks whether the patient is pregnant.
ex.zh: 表格询问病人是否怀孕。

ex.en: A pregnant teacher needs a chair and a timetable that does not pretend she is not.
ex.zh: 怀孕的老师需要一把椅子，以及一份不假装她没有怀孕的课表。

tip: pregnant 是形容词。本条用医务和学校场景，不写生理细节。

senses.en: a journey by air, or the act of flying

ex.en: Our flight leaves at seven in the morning.
ex.zh: 我们的航班早上七点起飞。

ex.en: A cancelled flight can separate a school group if nobody has written a meeting place.
ex.zh: 如果没人写下集合地点，取消的航班会把学校旅行团拆散。

col: a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯
tip: a flight of stairs 是一段楼梯，不是飞机。

senses.en: what a person knows

ex.en: Local knowledge of the river saved time.
ex.zh: 对这条河的本地知识节省了时间。

ex.en: Knowledge from a textbook and knowledge from a flooded street are both useful.
ex.zh: 来自课本的知识和来自积水街道的知识都有用。

tip: knowledge 不可数，不说 a knowledge，除非说 a knowledge of。

senses.en: arrangement, a command, or a request for goods
to command, or to ask for goods

ex.en: Put the books back in the right order.
ex.zh: 把书按正确顺序放回去。

ex.en: An order to close street markets at dusk can cut noise and also cut the income of small sellers.
ex.zh: 黄昏关闭街头市场的命令能减少噪音，也会减少小贩的收入。

tip: in order to do 表示目的；in order that 后接句子。

senses.en: very bad or frightening

ex.en: The noise was terrible during the drill.
ex.zh: 演习时噪音很糟。

ex.en: A terrible result on one quiz is information, not a final judgement of a student.
ex.zh: 一次小测的糟糕成绩是信息，不是对学生的最终判决。

tip: terrible 程度很强。terribly 在口语里也可表示“非常”。

senses.en: to experience a feeling or opinion

ex.en: I feel nervous before I speak in class.
ex.zh: 我在课堂上发言前感到紧张。

ex.en: Residents feel the effect of a new airport long before the official noise report is published.
ex.zh: 居民在官方噪音报告公布之前很久，就能感到新机场的影响。

tip: feel 作连系动词，后面接形容词：feel tired，不接 tiredly。

senses.en: to push something firmly
a push, or newspapers and journalists

ex.en: Press the button to open the door.
ex.zh: 按按钮开门。

ex.en: If editors press reporters to publish before they check, false stories spread faster.
ex.zh: 如果编辑催记者在核对之前发表，假消息会传得更快。

tip: the press 表示新闻界。

senses.en: the surface of the earth, or an area for sport

ex.en: The bag fell to the ground.
ex.zh: 包掉到了地上。

ex.en: A sports ground that floods every spring is a sign the drains need work.
ex.zh: 每年春天都积水的运动场，说明排水需要整修。

tip: ground 作“地面”时常不可数。grounds 可指场地或理由。

senses.en: a device meant to explode

ex.en: The station closed after a bomb scare.
ex.zh: 炸弹恐吓之后车站关闭了。

ex.en: A history lesson can name a bomb as an event and still refuse to explain how one is made.
ex.zh: 历史课可以把炸弹作为一个事件来写，同时拒绝说明它是怎么做成的。

tip: 本条只作词汇。不提供制造、使用或隐藏爆炸物的任何方法。

senses.en: all people born around the same time

ex.en: This generation grew up with the internet.
ex.zh: 这一代人在互联网中长大。

ex.en: A generation that leaves school during a drought may carry that memory into later votes.
ex.zh: 在干旱中离开学校的一代人，可能把这段记忆带进后来的投票。

col: from generation to generation｜世代相传
tip: generation 也可指产生，如 the generation of electricity。

senses.en: an animal with feathers and wings

ex.en: A bird nested in the school tree.
ex.zh: 一只鸟在学校的树上筑了巢。

ex.en: Birds leave a street when the trees leave, even if the signs stay.
ex.zh: 树走了，鸟也会离开那条街，即使牌子还在。

tip: bird 可数。鸟类总称可用 birds。

senses.en: an activity with rules, often for fun or sport

ex.en: Our class won the basketball game.
ex.zh: 我们班赢了篮球赛。

ex.en: A game that rewards only speed may discourage students who think carefully but slowly.
ex.zh: 只奖励速度的游戏，可能会让思考仔细但较慢的学生失去信心。

tip: game 可指一场比赛；match 更常用于正式体育赛事。

senses.en: an act that breaks the law

ex.en: Stealing a bike is a crime.
ex.zh: 偷自行车是犯罪。

ex.en: A city reduces crime more reliably by lighting streets and offering work than by fear alone.
ex.zh: 城市若想更稳妥地减少犯罪，靠路灯和工作机会比只靠恐惧更有效。

tip: crime 可数也可指犯罪这一类行为。不要把 crime 和 sin 混用。

senses.en: to get away from a place or danger
an act of escaping, or a way out

ex.en: The cat escaped through the open window.
ex.zh: 猫从开着的窗户跑了。

ex.en: A fire escape that is locked is not an escape.
ex.zh: 锁上的消防通道就不是出口。

tip: escape 作名词是逃脱或出口。后接 from，也可直接接表示逃脱的事物。

senses.en: only one, or not married

ex.en: A single mistake in the date can spoil the form.
ex.zh: 日期上的一个错误就能让表格作废。

ex.en: A single tree cannot cool a playground, but a row of them can.
ex.zh: 一棵树凉不了一座操场，但一排树可以。

tip: single 强调仅一个；only 强调限制范围。

senses.en: not cooked, or not yet processed

ex.en: Do not eat the raw meat.
ex.zh: 不要吃生肉。

ex.en: Raw numbers without a source are not yet a report.
ex.zh: 没有来源的原始数字还不是一份报告。

tip: raw 可形容食物，也可形容未经处理的资料。

senses.en: a public garden in a town
to leave a vehicle somewhere

ex.en: The park is a short walk from school.
ex.zh: 公园离学校走路不远。

ex.en: A park on the edge of town helps little if children cannot cross the road to reach it.
ex.zh: 如果孩子过不了马路，城边的公园就帮不上什么忙。

tip: park 作动词是“停放车辆”。

senses.en: a male child

ex.en: The boy by the door is new.
ex.zh: 门边的男孩是新来的。

ex.en: A boy who wants to study nursing should see men doing that work, not only hear that it is allowed.
ex.zh: 想学护理的男孩应该看到有男性在做这份工作，而不只是听说这是允许的。

tip: boy 的复数是 boys。

senses.en: a farm bird, or its meat

ex.en: The soup has chicken in it.
ex.zh: 这汤里有鸡肉。

ex.en: Chicken that is not kept cold is a health problem, not only a smell.
ex.zh: 没有冷藏的鸡肉是健康问题，而不只是气味。

tip: chicken 作肉不可数，作一只鸡可数。

senses.en: the white drink from cows
to take milk from an animal

ex.en: There is milk in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱里有牛奶。

ex.en: Milk that sits out all morning is not a safe drink for the afternoon class.
ex.zh: 放了一上午的牛奶，不适合下午的课再喝。

col: a glass of milk｜一杯牛奶
tip: milk 作物质名词不可数。作动词是挤奶。

senses.en: right for a purpose

ex.en: The room is suitable for a quiet test.
ex.zh: 这个房间适合安静的测验。

ex.en: A suitable time for parents is not the middle of their shift.
ex.zh: 适合家长的时间不是他们班次的正中间。

tip: 动词 suit 已在本库。suitable for something。

senses.en: the organ where food goes, or the front of the body

ex.en: His stomach hurt after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后他胃疼。

ex.en: A stomach pain is a reason to call the clinic, not to finish the match.
ex.zh: 胃疼是叫医务室的理由，不是把比赛打完。

tip: stomach 可数。

senses.en: a type or shape, or a printed document
to make or shape

ex.en: Please fill in the form in pen.
ex.zh: 请用钢笔填表。

ex.en: Friendship can take the form of sharing notes, not only of sitting together at lunch.
ex.zh: 友谊可以表现为分享笔记，而不只是午饭坐在一起。

col: in the form of｜以……的形式
tip: form 作动词是“形成”或“组成”。

senses.en: an account of events, true or imagined

ex.en: The teacher told a short story before class ended.
ex.zh: 老师在下课前讲了一个短故事。

ex.en: A news story should name its sources, or readers cannot judge whether it is fair.
ex.zh: 一篇新闻报道应该写明来源，否则读者无法判断它是否公正。

tip: story 的复数是 stories。美式里 story 也可表示楼层。

senses.en: safe, or free from worry
to get, or to make safe

ex.en: The lab door is secure at night.
ex.zh: 实验室的门夜里是锁好的。

ex.en: A secure job for one parent can decide whether a child stays at the same school.
ex.zh: 父母一方有稳定的工作，可以决定孩子是否留在同一所学校。

col: secure a place｜获得一个名额
tip: secure 作动词是获得或使牢固。名词安全是 security，已在本库。

senses.en: careful listening or looking

ex.en: Pay attention to the last sentence.
ex.zh: 注意最后一句。

ex.en: Public attention lasts a day after a flood, but the damaged road lasts for months.
ex.zh: 洪水之后公众的注意只持续一天，但损坏的路会持续数月。

tip: attention 不可数。pay attention to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: a kind or sort
to write with a keyboard

ex.en: This type of question appears every year.
ex.zh: 这类题每年都出现。

ex.en: The type of housing a city builds decides who can live near work and school.
ex.zh: 一座城市建造的住房类型，决定谁能住在工作和学校附近。

tip: type 作动词是“打字”。

senses.en: a set of actions done in order

ex.en: The procedure is on the lab door.
ex.zh: 程序写在实验室门上。

ex.en: A fire procedure that nobody has practised is only a piece of paper.
ex.zh: 没人演练过的消防程序只是一张纸。

tip: procedure 可数。本条不写危险操作的具体步骤。

senses.en: a round fruit

ex.en: She brought an apple for the break.
ex.zh: 她带了一个苹果当课间点心。

ex.en: An apple sold at the school gate should be washed, and the price should be clear.
ex.zh: 校门口卖的苹果应当洗过，价格也应当写清。

tip: apple 可数。an apple，不是 a apple。

senses.en: to make sure something is true
To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

ex.en: Please confirm your email address.
ex.zh: 请确认你的电子邮箱地址。

ex.en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。

tip: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。

senses.en: the outer covering of a body or fruit

ex.en: Cold wind can dry the skin on your hands.
ex.zh: 冷风会让手上的皮肤变干。

ex.en: Schools that teach sun safety help students protect their skin without fearing a normal day outside.
ex.zh: 教防晒的学校能帮助学生保护皮肤，又不必害怕正常的户外活动。

tip: skin 通常不可数。果皮、兽皮有时可用 a skin。

senses.en: American spelling of theatre

ex.en: The class visits the theater on Thursday.
ex.zh: 班级周四去剧院。

ex.en: A theater that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
ex.zh: 在末班车之后才开演的剧院，其实已经选定了谁能来。

tip: theater 是美式，theatre 是英式，已在本库。两条都保留。

senses.en: a person who decides in a court or a competition
to form an opinion

ex.en: The judge asked both sides to speak.
ex.zh: 法官请双方发言。

ex.en: A judge of a school contest should look at the work, not at who the student's parents are.
ex.zh: 学校比赛的裁判应该看作品，而不是看学生的父母是谁。

tip: judge 作动词是“判断”。

senses.en: making a lot of noise

ex.en: The bell is loud enough.
ex.zh: 铃已经够响了。

ex.en: A loud hallway makes the quiet student miss the instruction.
ex.zh: 吵闹的走廊会让安静的学生听漏说明。

tip: loud 也可作副词，但 loudly 更常见。

senses.en: the gas around the earth

ex.en: Open a window and let in some fresh air.
ex.zh: 开窗透透新鲜空气。

ex.en: Dirty air around a school is not a small local problem when thousands of children breathe it daily.
ex.zh: 当数千名孩子每天呼吸学校周围的脏空气时，这就不是一件小事。

tip: air 通常不可数。by air 表示乘飞机。

senses.en: something you must do

ex.en: It is my duty to lock up.
ex.zh: 锁门是我的职责。

ex.en: Duty on imported books can decide whether a school library grows.
ex.zh: 进口书的税可以决定学校图书馆是否增长。

tip: on duty 是值班。off duty 是下班。duty 也可指关税。

senses.en: a formal request; a use
the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods
a computer program designed to perform particular tasks

ex.en: Send your application before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前递交你的申请。

ex.en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
ex.zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。

tip: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

senses.en: a chemical element found in all living things

ex.en: The lesson names carbon, not a recipe.
ex.zh: 这一课只讲碳这个名称，不讲配方。

ex.en: Cities cut carbon by changing buses, not only by printing a poster.
ex.zh: 城市减少碳排放靠的是改公交，而不只是印一张海报。

tip: carbon 通常不可数。本条只作元素词汇，不写任何制备方法。

senses.en: a group working or playing together

ex.en: Our team practises on Wednesday evenings.
ex.zh: 我们队周三晚上训练。

ex.en: A rescue team is only as fast as the roads and phone signals that connect it to a village.
ex.zh: 救援队的速度，取决于连接它和村庄的道路与手机信号。

tip: team 作整体时谓语可用单数；强调成员时可用复数。

senses.en: the time when you are a child

ex.en: She spent her childhood in this town.
ex.zh: 她的童年在这座城镇度过。

ex.en: A safe path to school is part of childhood, not an extra.
ex.zh: 一条安全的上学路是童年的一部分，不是额外的东西。

tip: childhood 通常不可数。child 已在本库。

senses.en: a necktie, a connection, or an equal result
to fasten with a string, or to finish equal

ex.en: He wore a tie for the photo.
ex.zh: 他拍照时打了领带。

ex.en: The match ended in a tie, and both classes still needed the same bus.
ex.zh: 比赛以平局结束，两个班仍然需要同一班车。

tip: tie 作动词是系、打成平局。

senses.en: a person who is not named

ex.en: Somebody left a bag in the lab.
ex.zh: 有人把包落在实验室了。

ex.en: Somebody has to lock the hall, or the lights stay on all night.
ex.zh: 必须有人锁礼堂，否则灯会亮一整夜。

tip: somebody 后接单数动词。和 someone 同义，本库两条都保留。

senses.en: a business company
strong, or not changing your decision

ex.en: Her aunt works at a small design firm.
ex.zh: 她阿姨在一家小型设计公司工作。

ex.en: A firm that trains local students can keep jobs in the town after they graduate.
ex.zh: 培训当地学生的公司，可以在他们毕业后把工作留在镇上。

tip: firm 作形容词是“坚定的；坚固的”。作名词多指公司。

senses.en: the act of buying
to buy

ex.en: Keep the receipt for every purchase.
ex.zh: 每次购买都留着收据。

ex.en: A large purchase for the lab should be checked by more than one person.
ex.zh: 实验室的大额采购应当由不止一个人核对。

tip: purchase 比 buy 正式。作动词直接接所买的东西。

senses.en: a human being

ex.en: She is the right person to ask about the map.
ex.zh: 问地图的事，她是合适的人。

ex.en: A person who cannot afford the bus may never see the museum the city is proud of.
ex.zh: 付不起公交费的人，可能永远看不到这座城市引以为傲的博物馆。

tip: person 的复数通常是 people，不常说 persons。

senses.en: a road in a town with buildings

ex.en: Our school is on a quiet street.
ex.zh: 我们学校在一条安静的街上。

ex.en: A street without a pavement pushes children into the same space as cars.
ex.zh: 没有人行道的街道，把孩子推进和汽车相同的空间。

tip: in the street 和 on the street 都可以，英式更常用 in。

senses.en: to have something as a part

ex.en: The price includes lunch.
ex.zh: 价格里包括午餐。

ex.en: A transport plan should include the walk from the last bus stop to the school gate.
ex.zh: 交通计划应该包括从末班车站走到校门的那段路。

tip: including 是介词，后面接名词。

senses.en: to go to live somewhere, or to end a problem

ex.en: They settled in the town last year.
ex.zh: 他们去年在这座城镇定居。

ex.en: Settle the bus argument in writing.
ex.zh: 把公交的争论用书面解决。

tip: 名词 settlement 已在本库。

senses.en: the part of a person that thinks
to be annoyed by, or to be careful

ex.en: I changed my mind after I read the article.
ex.zh: 读完那篇文章后我改变了主意。

ex.en: A tired mind makes careless mistakes, which is why sleep belongs in any study plan.
ex.zh: 疲惫的头脑会犯粗心的错误，所以任何学习计划都该包括睡眠。

col: make up one's mind｜下定决心
tip: mind 作动词是“介意”：Would you mind doing...?

senses.en: a device or system for sending sound

ex.en: The weather news is on the radio.
ex.zh: 天气新闻在收音机里。

ex.en: A radio warning still reaches homes that have lost the phone signal.
ex.zh: 收音机警报仍然能到达失去手机信号的家庭。

tip: listen to the radio，要用 to。

senses.en: having drunk too much alcohol

ex.en: He was not drunk; he was ill.
ex.zh: 他不是醉了，他是病了。

ex.en: A school event should not treat getting drunk as a joke.
ex.zh: 学校活动不应当把喝醉当成笑话。

tip: drunk 是 drink 的过去分词，也可作形容词。drink 已在本库。本条不写如何喝醉。

senses.en: very small

ex.en: A tiny crack can leak all night.
ex.zh: 一条极小的裂缝可以漏一整夜。

ex.en: A tiny school still needs a way to call a doctor.
ex.zh: 极小的学校仍然需要叫到医生的办法。

tip: tiny 比 small 更小。比较级 tinier，最高级 tiniest。

senses.en: a pity, or a feeling of guilt

ex.en: It is a shame that the library closes at five.
ex.zh: 图书馆五点关门，真可惜。

ex.en: Shame is a poor way to teach a student who already knows the answer was wrong.
ex.zh: 对已经知道答案错了的学生，羞愧是很差的教法。

tip: It is a shame 常表示可惜，不一定是道德上的羞耻。

senses.en: ready and happy to do something

ex.en: She is willing to share her notes.
ex.zh: 她愿意分享笔记。

ex.en: A town is willing to fund a library when residents can see who uses it.
ex.zh: 当居民能看到谁在用图书馆时，城镇就更愿意出钱。

tip: willing 后接 to do。名词是 willingness。

senses.en: frozen water

ex.en: There was ice on the path this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨小路上有冰。

ex.en: Ice on the only road to school can close a village for a day.
ex.zh: 唯一上学路上的冰，可以让一个村子停课一天。

tip: ice 通常不可数。

senses.en: to examine to see if something is correct
an examination, or an American bank form

ex.en: Check your name before you hand in the paper.
ex.zh: 交卷前核对你的名字。

ex.en: Cities should check air quality outside schools, not only in the parks that look good in photos.
ex.zh: 城市应该检查学校外面的空气质量，而不只是照片里好看的公园。

tip: check 直接接宾语。支票是 cheque（英）或 check（美）。

senses.en: the end of the day and the early night

ex.en: We have choir practice in the evening.
ex.zh: 我们晚上排练合唱。

ex.en: Evening classes let working adults study without leaving their daytime jobs.
ex.zh: 夜校让上班的成年人不必辞去白天的工作也能学习。

tip: 泛指晚上用 in the evening。具体某一天的晚上用 on Monday evening。

senses.en: coming at the end

ex.en: This is the final day to hand in the form.
ex.zh: 今天是交表的最后一天。

ex.en: A final decision on a new road should wait until residents have seen the plan.
ex.zh: 关于新路的最终决定，应该等到居民看过方案之后。

tip: final 强调不可再改的最后；last 强调顺序上的最后一个。

senses.en: all things

ex.en: Everything is ready for the open day.
ex.zh: 开放日的一切都准备好了。

ex.en: A school cannot control everything a child sees online, so it should teach how to pause and check.
ex.zh: 学校无法控制孩子在网上看到的一切，所以应该教他们如何停下来核对。

tip: everything 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: not common

ex.en: This bird is rare in our city.
ex.zh: 这种鸟在我们城市很罕见。

ex.en: A rare book in a school library needs a rule about who may take it home.
ex.zh: 学校图书馆里的珍本书需要规定谁可以借回家。

tip: rarely 放在实义动词前、助动词后。

senses.en: the direction where the sun goes down
in or towards the west

ex.en: The sun sets in the west.
ex.zh: 太阳在西边落下。

ex.en: Towns in the west of the region share one hospital, so the road between them matters.
ex.zh: 该地区西部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路很重要。

tip: western 是形容词。the West 有时特指西方国家。

senses.en: of citizens, or polite

ex.en: Civil society groups helped after the flood.
ex.zh: 民间团体在洪水后提供了帮助。

ex.en: Civil talk in a meeting still needs someone to record who will do the work.
ex.zh: 会议上文明的谈话，仍然需要有人记下谁来干活。

tip: civil 不是“国内战争”本身；内战是 civil war。

senses.en: the state of not having enough
to not have enough

ex.en: The lack of light makes the road unsafe.
ex.zh: 缺少灯光让这条路不安全。

ex.en: A lack of buses, not a lack of effort, explains why some students arrive late.
ex.zh: 一些学生迟到，原因是缺少公交，不是缺少努力。

tip: lack 作动词直接接宾语：lack time，不加 of。

senses.en: a boy or man with the same parents

ex.en: My brother walks to school with me.
ex.zh: 我哥哥和我一起走路上学。

ex.en: A brother who leaves for the city may send money home, but the family loses his daily help.
ex.zh: 去城市的兄弟也许会寄钱回家，但家里失去了他日常的帮忙。

tip: brother 的复数是 brothers。

senses.en: lack of success
a situation in which a machine or organ stops working
not doing something that is expected or required

ex.en: failure can teach useful lessons.
ex.zh: 失败能教会有用的功课。

ex.en: Schools should treat failure as an opportunity for learning rather than as evidence of a student's limited ability.
ex.zh: 学校应将失败视为学习的机会，而不是学生能力有限的证明。

tip: 泛指失败通常不可数；a failure可指失败的事物。

senses.en: to take part

ex.en: Every class may participate.
ex.zh: 每个班都可以参加。

ex.en: Students participate more when the meeting is not only for the loud voices.
ex.zh: 当会议不只是给嗓门大的人时，学生会更多地参加。

tip: participate in something。比 join 更正式。

senses.en: a feeling of not being sure
to feel unsure

ex.en: I have no doubt that she prepared well.
ex.zh: 我毫不怀疑她准备得很充分。

ex.en: A useful doubt makes a reader check a number twice instead of sharing it at once.
ex.zh: 有用的怀疑会让读者把数字核对两遍，而不是立刻转发。

tip: doubt 作动词时，肯定句后的从句常用 whether 或 if。

senses.en: of people
a person

ex.en: Clean water is a basic human need.
ex.zh: 干净的水是人的基本需要。

ex.en: Human activity along a river, from farms to factories, decides whether the water stays drinkable.
ex.zh: 河边的人类活动，从农场到工厂，决定水是否还能饮用。

tip: human 可作形容词或名词；一个人更常说 a person 或 a human being。

senses.en: a very high hill

ex.en: Snow stays on the mountain in May.
ex.zh: 五月山上还有雪。

ex.en: A school on the far side of a mountain needs a road that works in winter.
ex.zh: 山那一边的学校需要一条冬天也能走的路。

tip: mountain 比 hill 高。山脉常用 the ... Mountains。

senses.en: a time without war, or quiet

ex.en: The square was at peace after the fair.
ex.zh: 义卖之后广场安静下来。

ex.en: Peace in a neighbourhood also means a street where children can walk without fear.
ex.zh: 社区的安宁也意味着一条孩子可以不怕地走路的街。

tip: peace 不可数。

senses.en: to move your hand, or to move like water
a moving line of water, or a form of energy

ex.en: Wave when you see the bus.
ex.zh: 看见公交时挥一下手。

ex.en: A heat wave closes sport sooner than a poster about water.
ex.zh: 热浪比一张关于喝水的海报更快让体育课停下来。

tip: wave 作名词是波浪、电波或一阵。heat wave 已在前面批次的搭配里出现过，这里作为本词的名词义。

senses.en: to strike, or to reach a level
a blow, or something very popular

ex.en: The ball hit the window but did not break it.
ex.zh: 球打到窗户，但没有打破。

ex.en: When summer temperatures hit a new high, schools without fans struggle to keep lessons going.
ex.zh: 当夏天气温创下新高时，没有风扇的学校很难把课继续下去。

col: hit sb on the head｜打某人的头
tip: hit 的过去式和过去分词都是 hit。打在某人某个部位用 hit sb on the + 部位。

senses.en: a country ruled by a king or queen

ex.en: The story is set in a small kingdom.
ex.zh: 故事发生在一个小王国。

ex.en: A history of a kingdom should also say who grew the food.
ex.zh: 王国的历史也应当写是谁种的粮食。

tip: the United Kingdom 缩写是 the UK。king 已在本库。

senses.en: fairly hot, or friendly

ex.en: The classroom is warm enough.
ex.zh: 教室足够暖和。

ex.en: A warm welcome matters, and so does a seat for the parent who came straight from work.
ex.zh: 热情的欢迎很重要，刚下班赶来的家长有没有座位也很重要。

tip: warm 比 hot 温度低、语气也更温和。

senses.en: the time after now

ex.en: We talked about our future plans.
ex.zh: 我们谈了未来的计划。

ex.en: The future of a riverside town depends on whether the water stays clean enough to drink.
ex.zh: 河边城镇的未来，取决于水是否仍然干净到可以饮用。

tip: in the future 指将来；in future 常表示“今后”，带有从现在改起的意味。

senses.en: anything, or no matter what

ex.en: Take whatever you need from the box.
ex.zh: 盒子里你需要什么就拿什么。

ex.en: Whatever a poster promises, the bus still has to arrive before the first lesson.
ex.zh: 无论海报承诺什么，公交仍必须在第一节课前到达。

tip: whatever 可引导让步状语从句，相当于 no matter what。

senses.en: a photograph of the inside of the body

ex.en: The clinic sent the X-ray to the hospital.
ex.zh: 诊所把 X 光片送到了医院。

ex.en: An X-ray is a medical record, not a picture for the notice board.
ex.zh: X 光片是医疗记录，不是布告栏上的图片。

col: an X-ray of｜……的 X 光片
tip: X-ray 的 X 要大写。也可作动词“给……拍 X 光”。

senses.en: to move towards the speaker or a place

ex.en: Come to the hall when you hear the bell.
ex.zh: 听到铃声就到大厅来。

ex.en: New businesses come to a town only when roads, power, and schools are already reliable.
ex.zh: 只有当道路、电力和学校已经可靠时，新的商家才会来到一个城镇。

tip: come 的过去式是 came，过去分词是 come。

senses.en: to take food into the body

ex.en: We eat lunch in the classroom on rainy days.
ex.zh: 下雨天我们在教室吃午饭。

ex.en: Students eat more packaged food when the school canteen closes before the last lesson.
ex.zh: 当食堂在最后一节课前关闭时，学生会吃更多包装食品。

tip: eat 的过去式是 ate，过去分词是 eaten。

senses.en: a member of your family
considered in relation to something else

ex.en: A relative will meet her at the station.
ex.zh: 一位亲戚会在车站接她。

ex.en: A form that asks for a relative should also leave space if there is none nearby.
ex.zh: 要求填写亲戚的表格，如果附近没有亲戚，也应当留出说明的地方。

tip: relative 作形容词是相对的。relative to 表示与……相比或相关。

senses.en: close to
not far
at a short distance

ex.en: There is a bus stop near the gate.
ex.zh: 门口附近有一个公交站。

ex.en: Clinics near schools make it easier for a sick child to be seen and then return home.
ex.zh: 学校附近的诊所，让生病的孩子更容易看病然后回家。

tip: near 可作介词、形容词或副词。nearly 是“几乎”，不是“附近”。

senses.en: to move steadily, like water
a steady movement

ex.en: The stream flows under the bridge.
ex.zh: 小溪从桥下流过。

ex.en: Traffic should flow past a school gate, not stop across the crossing.
ex.zh: 车流应当从校门口经过，而不是停在斑马线上。

tip: flow 作名词是流动或流量。

senses.en: a mother or father

ex.en: A parent must sign the form.
ex.zh: 必须有家长在表上签字。

ex.en: Parents who work late need a meeting time that is not in the middle of the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下班晚的家长需要一个不是下午正中的见面时间。

tip: parent 可数。parents 常指双亲。

senses.en: a machine that carries people between floors; British
to raise

ex.en: The lift is out of order.
ex.zh: 电梯坏了。

ex.en: A lift that stops is a problem for the student who cannot use the stairs.
ex.zh: 停运的电梯对不能走楼梯的学生是问题。

tip: 英式 lift 是电梯，美式常用 elevator。作动词是举起。

senses.en: known by many people

ex.en: The town is famous for its lake.
ex.zh: 这座城镇以湖闻名。

ex.en: A famous name on a poster does not prove that the advice is right for teenagers.
ex.zh: 海报上的著名名字，并不能证明那条建议适合青少年。

tip: 因某事闻名用 famous for；作为某种身份闻名用 famous as。

senses.en: an arrangement to meet at a set time

ex.en: The appointment is at four.
ex.zh: 预约在四点。

ex.en: An appointment at the clinic should not depend on a bus that has already stopped.
ex.zh: 诊所的预约不应当依赖已经停运的公交。

tip: appointment 也可指任命。

senses.en: the anniversary of the day someone was born

ex.en: Her birthday is in March.
ex.zh: 她的生日在三月。

ex.en: A birthday in term time is easier to share when the class does not expect an expensive gift.
ex.zh: 学期中的生日，如果班级不期待昂贵的礼物，就更容易一起过。

tip: birthday 是每年的生日。birth 是出生，本批另有词条。

senses.en: a yellow fat made from milk

ex.en: There is butter on the bread.
ex.zh: 面包上有黄油。

ex.en: Butter left in the sun is not safe for lunch.
ex.zh: 放在太阳下的黄油用来做午饭不安全。

tip: butter 通常不可数。

senses.en: a place of higher or further education

ex.en: He hopes to study art at college.
ex.zh: 他希望在大学学艺术。

ex.en: A college far from cheap housing leaves students working nights just to pay the rent.
ex.zh: 远离廉价住房的大学，会让学生为了付房租而上夜班。

tip: 在美式英语里 college 常泛指大学。

senses.en: to shut
near, or intimate
near

ex.en: Please close the door quietly.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门。

ex.en: Shops that close early leave night-shift workers with nowhere nearby to buy food.
ex.zh: 早关门的商店，让夜班工人附近没有地方买食物。

tip: close 作形容词读 /kləʊs/，表示“近的”；作动词读 /kləʊz/。

senses.en: done by or true for everyone

ex.en: The need for sleep is universal.
ex.zh: 对睡眠的需要是普遍的。

ex.en: A universal rule still fails if the form has no space for a wheelchair.
ex.zh: 如果表格没有轮椅的位置，一条普遍规则仍然会失败。

tip: universe 已在本库。universal 是形容词。

senses.en: to stay until something happens

ex.en: Please wait for me at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口等我。

ex.en: Children who wait for a bus in the dark need a light and a shelter, not only a timetable.
ex.zh: 在黑暗中等公交的孩子需要灯和候车亭，而不只是时刻表。

tip: wait 是不及物动词，必须加 for 再接等待的对象。

senses.en: to understand, or to make something real

ex.en: I did not realize the gate was locked.
ex.zh: 我没有意识到门已经锁了。

ex.en: A town can realize a library plan only after it finds both a room and a librarian.
ex.zh: 一座城镇只有在找到房间和馆员之后，才能实现建图书馆的计划。

tip: realize 有两个常用义：明白，以及实现。英式也可拼成 realise。本库用考纲里的 realize。

senses.en: below, or less than

ex.en: The cat is sleeping under the desk.
ex.zh: 猫在书桌下睡觉。

ex.en: Children under six need shorter lessons and more time to move than a standard timetable allows.
ex.zh: 六岁以下的孩子需要比标准课表更短的课和更多活动时间。

tip: under 可表示在下方，也可表示少于某个年龄或数量。

senses.en: the people who live in a place

ex.en: The population of the town is growing.
ex.zh: 这个城镇的人口在增长。

ex.en: A rising population needs schools and clinics, not only more flats.
ex.zh: 增长的人口需要学校和诊所，而不只是更多公寓。

tip: population 作整体时谓语常用单数。

senses.en: belonging to one person

ex.en: Please do not read my personal notes.
ex.zh: 请不要看我的私人笔记。

ex.en: Personal data from a school app should stay with the school, not be sold.
ex.zh: 学校应用里的个人数据应该留在学校，不该被卖掉。

tip: personal 强调属于个人；personnel 是“全体人员”，不要拼混。

senses.en: able to happen or be done

ex.en: Is it possible to finish today?
ex.zh: 今天做完可能吗？

ex.en: It is possible to cut traffic if buses are frequent enough that people leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 如果公交足够频繁、人们把车留在家里，减少车流是可能的。

tip: It is possible for sb to do。possible 的主语通常是事物或 it，不是人。
